mapper.sql: document.school_id = #{schoolId} and document.status = 'PUBLISHED' and (document.effective_at is null or document.effective_at <= current_timestamp) and (document.expires_at is null or document.expires_at > current_timestamp)
mapper.select: select chunk.id, chunk.document_id, chunk.chunk_index, chunk.content from knowledge_chunks chunk inner join knowledge_documents document on document.id = chunk.document_id left join knowledge_chunk_embeddings embedding on embedding.chunk_id = chunk.id and embedding.model = #{model} where and embedding.chunk_id is null order by chunk.id asc limit #{limit}

select chunk.id as chunk_id, document.id as document_id, document.title, document.category, document.source_department, document.source_url, document.published_at, chunk.content from knowledge_chunks chunk inner join knowledge_documents document on document.id = chunk.document_id where and chunk.id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_chunk_embeddings (chunk_id, model, dimensions, vector_json) values (#{chunkId}, #{model}, #{dimensions}, #{vectorJson}) on duplicate key update model = values(model), dimensions = values(dimensions), vector_json = values(vector_json), updated_at = current_timestamp
